# AcerolaFX texture sources

`fillASCII.png` and `edgesASCII.png` are unmodified source textures from
[Garrett Gunnell's AcerolaFX repository](https://github.com/GarrettGunnell/AcerolaFX/tree/main/Textures).
They are distributed under the accompanying MIT license.

The runtime texture at
`My project/Assets/AsciiShader/Textures/GlyphAtlas.png` is derived from
`fillASCII.png`. Its `p` and `?` glyph masks were adjusted for this project's
square-cell luminance ramp.
